dialogues.jp: 「そうだな、一緒に食うのも悪くないな」
dialogues.en: "I guess there's no problem in eating lunch together."
dialogues.text: "I guess there's no problem in eating lunch together."

dialogues.jp:
ふだんバナナバナナしか言わない美春だったが、
これでなかなか料理上手なのだ。
dialogues.en:
Despite her obsession with bananas, Miharu's actually very
good at cooking.
dialogues.text:
Despite her obsession with bananas, Miharu's actually very
good at cooking.

dialogues.jp:
はっきり言って、プロ級。今すぐにでも店が持
てるんじゃないかって、俺は思ってる。
dialogues.en:
To put it bluntly, she's a pro at it. She could easily
opened her own store selling her food right now, in my
opinion.
dialogues.text:
To put it bluntly, she's a pro at it. She could easily
opened her own store selling her food right now, in my
opinion.

dialogues.jp:
味気ないパンではない豪勢な弁当を夢見て、唾
液が勝手に｛にじ／滲｝み出てくる。
dialogues.en:
The thought of actually eating a well-crafted boxed lunch
instead of the everyday bread was making my mouth water.
dialogues.text:
The thought of actually eating a well-crafted boxed lunch
instead of the everyday bread was making my mouth water.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、中庭にでも行って食べるか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to the courtyard to eat."
dialogues.text: "Let's go to the courtyard to eat."

dialogues.jp: 俺が言うと、美春が小首を傾げた。
dialogues.en: Miharu tilted her head slightly at my words.
dialogues.text: Miharu tilted her head slightly at my words.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「何言ってるんですか、朝倉先輩。食堂へれっ
　つごー！　ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"What are you talking about, Asakura-senpai. Let's go to the
cafeteria!"
dialogues.text:
"What are you talking about, Asakura-senpai. Let's go to the
cafeteria!"

dialogues.jp: 美春が俺の腕をとって、ズンズン歩き出す。
dialogues.en: Miharu grabbed my arm, and started walking rapidly.
dialogues.text: Miharu grabbed my arm, and started walking rapidly.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おい、ちょっと待て美春」
dialogues.en: "O, oy, wait a minute Miharu."
dialogues.text: "O, oy, wait a minute Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
「どうして食堂に行かにゃならんのだ。これだ
　け天気がいいんだ、外で食った方が美味いだ
　ろうが」
dialogues.en:
"Why do we need to eat in the cafeteria? The weather is
great outside, and food always tastes better outdoors."
dialogues.text:
"Why do we need to eat in the cafeteria? The weather is
great outside, and food always tastes better outdoors."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それはそうですけど、美春は食堂に行かない
　とお昼ご飯食べられないですもん」
dialogues.en: "Even so, I can't eat lunch if I don't go to the cafeteria!"
dialogues.text: "Even so, I can't eat lunch if I don't go to the cafeteria!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと待て。それはどういうことだ？」
dialogues.en: "...Wait. What did you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "...Wait. What did you mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「簡単なことですよ。実はですね、今日お弁当
　もお財布も忘れて来てしまいまして」
dialogues.en:
"It's simple! I just forgot my purse and lunchbox today,
that's all!"
dialogues.text:
"It's simple! I just forgot my purse and lunchbox today,
that's all!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それって何か？　俺にオゴレって言ってるん
　だな、お前は」
dialogues.en: "...So basically, you wanted me to treat you."
dialogues.text: "...So basically, you wanted me to treat you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……えーっと……その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah... well... that's..."
dialogues.text: "Ah... well... that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは。さっすが、朝倉先輩！　察しが
　いいですねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahahahaha, just as I expected, Asakura-senpai! Your
perception is fantastic!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahahahaha, just as I expected, Asakura-senpai! Your
perception is fantastic!"

dialogues.jp: 笑って誤魔化す美春。
dialogues.en: Such a wily, deceptive laugh, Miharu.
dialogues.text: Such a wily, deceptive laugh, Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 「ひとりで食え」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to eat alone now."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to eat alone now."

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春を置いて歩き出した。
dialogues.en: I walk away from her.
dialogues.text: I walk away from her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんな〜。待ってくださいよぉ」
dialogues.en: "That...that's~ Please wait~"
dialogues.text: "That...that's~ Please wait~"

dialogues.jp: 切なそうな美春の声が、俺の背中にぶつかる。
dialogues.en: Miharu's pitiful voice struck me from behind.
dialogues.text: Miharu's pitiful voice struck me from behind.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みでそこら辺を歩いていた学生達が、何事
かとこちらを見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Students passing by during lunch period all turned and
looked in my direction disapprovingly.
dialogues.text:
Students passing by during lunch period all turned and
looked in my direction disapprovingly.

dialogues.jp: （う。視線が痛い……）
dialogues.en: "(Oof. Those looks...)"
dialogues.text: "(Oof. Those looks...)"

dialogues.jp: 俺は立ち止まると、盛大にため息を吐き出した。
dialogues.en: I stop walking, and let out a monstrous sigh.
dialogues.text: I stop walking, and let out a monstrous sigh.

dialogues.jp: 「美春、和菓子食えたか？」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, do you eat wagashis?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu, do you eat wagashis?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え……あ、はい。食べられますよ。バナナの
　方がずっと好きですけど」
dialogues.en: "Eh... ah, yeah. I've eaten them. Bananas are better."
dialogues.text: "Eh... ah, yeah. I've eaten them. Bananas are better."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そんな贅沢はこの際却下だ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think you're in much of a position to be choosy
right now."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think you're in much of a position to be choosy
right now."

dialogues.jp:
小首を傾げた美春の視界から片手を隠し、和菓
子を生み出す。
dialogues.en:
Miharu tilted her head again, which gave me the time I
needed to hide my hand from her field of vision and quickly
create a wagashi.
dialogues.text:
Miharu tilted her head again, which gave me the time I
needed to hide my hand from her field of vision and quickly
create a wagashi.

dialogues.jp:
「俺が食おうと思って開けちまった奴だが……
　やるよ」
dialogues.en: "If you're so hungry, then you can have this... here."
dialogues.text: "If you're so hungry, then you can have this... here."

dialogues.jp: 手の中の大福を美春にグッと差し出す。
dialogues.en: I handed her the daifuku that I just created.
dialogues.text: I handed her the daifuku that I just created.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わっ」
dialogues.en: "Waah!"
dialogues.text: "Waah!"

dialogues.jp: 慌てて受け取る美春。
dialogues.en: Miharu confusedly accepted my gift.
dialogues.text: Miharu confusedly accepted my gift.

dialogues.jp: 「もういいな？」
dialogues.en: "Is that enough?"
dialogues.text: "Is that enough?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい。大福、ありがとうございました〜」
dialogues.en: "Yes! Thank you for this daifuku~"
dialogues.text: "Yes! Thank you for this daifuku~"

dialogues.jp:
美春に背を向けて歩き出し、食べていなかった
パンを大急ぎで口にした。
dialogues.en:
Miharu quickly ran off in another direction, chewing
rapidly.
dialogues.text:
Miharu quickly ran off in another direction, chewing
rapidly.

dialogues.jp:
腹減ってる時に、そう何度も何度もやるもんじゃ
ないなぁ……。
dialogues.en:
She's probably the type who's hungry 24 hours a day, 7 days
a week...
dialogues.text:
She's probably the type who's hungry 24 hours a day, 7 days
a week...

dialogues.jp: ◆美春と食事？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miharu and meals?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miharu and meals?◆

dialogues.jp:
一緒に食べようと言ったのは、どうやら弁当も
財布も忘れてしまった美春が、俺におごっても
らおうという魂胆だったらしい。
dialogues.en:
Her innocent-sounding words were that of wanting to eat
together, but the truth was that she had forgotten her
lunchbox and purse, and she plotted to ask to eat lunch
together first, and explain later.
dialogues.text:
Her innocent-sounding words were that of wanting to eat
together, but the truth was that she had forgotten her
lunchbox and purse, and she plotted to ask to eat lunch
together first, and explain later.

dialogues.jp:
……ったく。そうならそうと最初から言えばい
いのに。
dialogues.en:
...Geez. If that's what it is, just say so from the start
already.
dialogues.text:
...Geez. If that's what it is, just say so from the start
already.

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春に和菓子を出してやるのだった。
dialogues.en: I created a wagashi and gave it to Miharu for her to eat.
dialogues.text: I created a wagashi and gave it to Miharu for her to eat.
